analytics.raw_text: Table 2 (printed Tabelle 2) gives the band maxima of the infrared spectrum of crystal modification I in [cm-1]: 37 values, from 593 to 3075. Lines 199 to 224. The full list is in the source and is not repeated here.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification I of tembotrione. Table 2 is analytical data only. The caption and the column header name the modification; the wavenumbers are measurements, not compounds.
